text: The server validates the credentials, generates a signed token, and the client includes it in every later request.
Each user gets a token bucket. Every request spends one token, and when the bucket is empty the server responds with HTTP 429.

El servidor valida las credenciales y genera un token firmado que el cliente envía en cada solicitud.
Refresh tokens expire after seven days, so users must sign in again once that period is over.
